Ἰωνο-αρχίω (
A. = -έω ), ib. 2420 . (The spelling Ἰωνό-βειρ- is correct, ib. 11(2) .l.c., Hdn.Gr. 2.411 : the form Ἰώνο-βιρ- is Boeot. (v. supr.) and late Gr., Milet. 6.26
(i A.D.), Alexio and Philox. ap. Et.Gud. 289.30 .) (The connexion with the Semitic root KBR 'great' (cf. the title Μεγάλοι Θεοί) is not certain; nor is that with Skt. Kúbera- (name of a divinity), fr. *Kabera-, cf. Patron. Kāberaká-.)
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
